title: AGA Evidence Bundle
description: Schema for AGA (Attested Governance Architecture) evidence bundles. Evidence bundles package sealed artifacts, enforcement receipts, and Merkle inclusion proofs into a single offline-verifiable JSON document.
$comment: NON-NORMATIVE / illustrative only. The authoritative structural floor is the strict six-step algorithm in aga-receipt-spec/CANONICAL_CONSTRUCTION_v2.md §6 (exactly the 15 receipt / 7 checkpoint fields, no additional properties, lowercase-hex, small-order-key rejection, etc.). This JSON Schema is deliberately looser and MUST NOT be used as the conformance oracle — the cross-stack vectors are.

_comment.description: Optional human-readable comment, ignored by validators.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Currently only 1.0 is defined.

bundle_id.description: Unique identifier for this evidence bundle.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the bundle was generated.

artifact.description: Sealed policy artifact. Required for internal format bundles, null or absent for SEP/gateway format.

receipts.description: Array of governance receipts. Format depends on bundle type (internal vs SEP).

merkle_proofs.description: Merkle inclusion proofs for receipt verification.

merkle_root.description: Root hash of the Merkle tree over all receipt leaf hashes.

public_key.description: Hex-encoded public key (Ed25519 = 64 hex chars, ML-DSA-65 or hybrid may be longer).

offline_capable.description: Whether this bundle can be verified without network access.

algorithm.description: Signing algorithm identifier. Present in SEP/gateway format bundles.

gateway_id.description: Identifier of the MCP gateway that produced this bundle.

policy_reference.description: Hash or URI of the governing policy document.

roughtime_attestations.description: External timestamp corroboration via Roughtime servers.

batch_metadata.description: Merkle batch metadata when receipt batching is enabled.

then.description: SEP/gateway format: receipts are SEPReceipt objects, artifact is not required.

else.description: Internal format: receipts are Receipt objects, artifact is required.

PolicyArtifact.title: PolicyArtifact
PolicyArtifact.description: A sealed policy artifact containing content hashes and cryptographic signature.

sealed_hash.description: SHA-256 hash binding the artifact to its content via length-prefixed hashing.

bytes_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the artifact bytes.

metadata_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the artifact metadata.

salt.description: Hex-encoded random salt used in sealed hash computation.

signature.description: Hex-encoded Ed25519 (or PQC) signature over canonical JSON of all artifact fields except signature.

Receipt.title: Receipt (Internal Format)
Receipt.description: A governance receipt in AGA internal continuity chain format.

leaf_hash.description: SHA-256 leaf hash for chain linking.

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the receipt payload.

signature.description: Hex-encoded signature over the payload hash.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the event.

SEPReceipt.title: SEPReceipt (MCP Gateway Format)
SEPReceipt.description: A governance receipt in Structured Enforcement Protocol format, produced by MCP gateways.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the decision.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool being governed.

policy_reference.description: Hash or URI of the governing policy.

arguments_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonicalized tool arguments, or empty string.

previous_receipt_hash.description: Chain hash of the previous receipt (empty string for first receipt).

public_key.description: Hex-encoded public key of the signer.

MerkleProof.title: MerkleProof
MerkleProof.description: A Merkle inclusion proof demonstrating that a leaf hash is part of the receipt tree.

leaf_index.description: Zero-based index of the leaf in the tree.

siblings.description: Sibling hashes along the path from leaf to root.

directions.description: Direction of each sibling (left or right).

IdentityMetadata.title: IdentityMetadata
IdentityMetadata.description: Cryptographic identity binding for the bundle signer.

certificate_chain.description: PEM-encoded certificate chain, leaf first, root last.

cert_chain_hash.description: SHA-256 hex hash of concatenated PEM certificates.

issued_at.description: When the identity credential was issued.

RoughtimeAttestation.title: RoughtimeAttestation
RoughtimeAttestation.description: External timestamp corroboration from a Roughtime server.
